evidence: Changes src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h, and src/index/tx_lookup_result.h to support index queries on pruned nodes.
rationale: Delivers a major user capability by resolving four long-standing issues requesting txindex support on pruned nodes (#10609 opened in 2017, #12651, #16182, and #35240). Operators of pruned nodes can now maintain a transaction index to locate historical transactions without storing the full chain.
